subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Which Android message actions should be in scope before maintainers adopt or replace the linked implementation: copy/select-only or the full Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply action sheet?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the issue asks for extra Share and Reply behavior beyond the core copy/select problem, and the current implementation candidate is a conflicting fork PR.

options.title: Approve focused copy/select first
options.body: Land Copy and Select Copy for normal message text now, with Share and Reply left for separate follow-up if maintainers want them.

options.title: Approve the full action sheet
options.body: Treat Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply as one Android chat UX feature and require proof for the complete sheet before closing this issue.

options.title: Pause implementation direction
options.body: Keep this issue as backlog and close or ignore the conflicting fork PR until an Android UI owner writes a narrower spec.

recommendation.title: Approve focused copy/select first
recommendation.body: Land Copy and Select Copy for normal message text now, with Share and Reply left for separate follow-up if maintainers want them.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Android chat and merged Android link work route through this account, making it the best available owner for product-scope arbitration from the history read.
